blind.description: A stylized wooden church pew featuring a paneled backrest, flat bench seat, carved side supports with decorative fleur-de-lis finials, and a lower rail holding two dark red kneeling cushions. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and fully continuous with hand-painted warm brown wood grain textures and deep red upholstery.
blind.from_above: An elongated horizontal rectangle with ornate finial ends extending slightly outwards, a thin rail along the top backrest, and a bench surface below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 5.5 feet wide (roughly equal to the figure's height).
